page.layout: One column of running text, with two-line italic references at the ends of some paragraphs. No marginal notes. Numbered sections (LXV to LXX) are set as centred bare numerals. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, gathering signature at bottom right.

main_text.p: subuertere moliantur, nihil aliud faciunt quā proximum suum potant subuersione lutulen-ta, verborum pugnis digladiantes, non ad ali-cuius vtilitatem, sed ad ruinam hominum sim-pliciorum. Epist. ad Epicletum[?], contra haereticos.
Eorum infania in id barathri recidit, vt sen-sus non amplius integros, & incolumes retine-ant: sed prorsus mentem vndecunq; vitiatam reportant. Ad Adelphium, contra Arianos.

Vidéntes se esse vndecunque notatos infa-miaque conscribillatos, ipsorumq; falsum do-gma apud omnes abominabile fieri, scelerum inuentores sese praebent, vt pusquam remissa cum veritate pugna, Christi perduelles hostes-que permaneant. Ibidem.
Isti pro veritate & rerum fide inane simula-chrum introduxerunt. Ibidem.
Pro moribus sui imperatoris circumambu-lant, quaerentes quem ex simpliciotibus deuo-rent. Ibidem.
Iudæ mores imitantur, Dominumq; relin-quunt, vt Caiaphae adhaereant. Ibidem.
Cum vnaquæq; hæresis sui cōmenti paren-tem habeat eum, qui ab initio peruersus, & ho-micida, & mendax fuit, ac pudore tam exosi

page.notes: Printed "ꝏ"-like mark before "Ad Adelphium" (a printer's sign or reference mark) is not clear; not transcribed. "Epicletum" is doubtful (possibly Epictetum). "simpliciotibus" is printed as shown, probably a misprint for "simplicioribus". The first line of the page continues from the previous page. A small stray mark at the lower left edge is not printed text and is omitted.
